name: @interviewiq/ai-service
description: Python FastAPI service (all LLM logic). This package.json only lets turbo/pnpm run its tasks alongside the Node apps — Python deps live in requirements.txt.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt pytest pytest-asyncio
scripts.dev: test -x .venv/bin/uvicorn || { echo "ai-service: no .venv — run: pnpm --filter @interviewiq/ai-service setup"; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: test -x .venv/bin/python || { echo "ai-service: no .venv — run: pnpm --filter @interviewiq/ai-service setup"; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
scripts.dev:interviewer: test -x .venv/bin/python || { echo "ai-service: no .venv — run: pnpm --filter @interviewiq/ai-service setup"; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/python -m app.interviewer.worker dev
